title.narrative: Nauru Australia Treaty Budget Support - Phase 1

description.narrative:
In support of the Treaty provisions, the Government of Australia (GOA) committed to provide significant budget support over five years to the Government of Nauru (GoN) to support Nauru’s economic resilience, fiscal stability and prosperity. The Nauru-Australia Treaty Budget Support - Phase 1 (NATBS-Phl) Program delivers an initial $5 million tranche of budget support to the GoN in accordance with the Treaty commitment. The goal of the Program is to support Nauru’s economic security and resilience through the provision of short-term budget support to the GoN. The key strategic objectives of the Program are to: (a) Enable short-term fiscal certainty for Nauru; and (b) Enable targeted expenditure to support critical State-Owned Enterprise service provision and infrastructure delivery.
